parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State $R=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt3$, or exact equivalent; ISW. [B1] Use a correct trigonometric formula to find $\alpha$, e.g. $\tan\alpha=1/\sqrt3$, $\cos\alpha=\sqrt3/2$, or $\sin\alpha=1/2$; the printed sign-error allowance applies, but invalid coefficient equations do not. [M1] Obtain $\alpha=\pi/6$ by correct working. [A1 CWO] Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use part (a) to express the integral as $A\int\sec^2(2x+\alpha)\,dx$ (or the printed minus variant); FT $\alpha$. [B1 FT] Integrate to $B\tan(2x+\alpha)$; FT $\alpha$. [B1 FT] Obtain $\frac18\tan(2x+\alpha)$, or exact equivalent with the correct coefficient. [B1 FT] Apply $x=0$ and $x=\pi/12$ in the correct order in the tangent expression; FT $\alpha$, with the printed special case available. [M1] Obtain $\sqrt3/12=1/(4\sqrt3)=1/\sqrt{48}$, or a single-term exact equivalent; $(\sqrt3-1/\sqrt3)/8$ must be simplified. [A1] Total: 5.
